title: Way Finding in the Infinite Imaginarium: Juxtaposing Epistemic Tempos and Modes
description: As we head through and past January 2024, I wondered if/that…

methods.name: Spatial metaphor of Known territory, Gray Zone, and Dark Imaginarium
methods.description: The essay frames inquiry as a situation divided into known, peripheral, and unknown territories.
methods.evidence: The Gray Zone is an ever-receding forager-specific situational periphery.

methods.name: Domino and Jenga-tower metaphors for speech acts and questions
methods.description: Uses stacked dominoes for uttered phonemes and verbal expression, and a Jenga tower for a question built by the questioner.
methods.evidence: A question is like a Jenga tower assembled by the questioner

methods.name: Illustrative student-librarian example (Alice and Bob)
methods.description: Walks through Alice asking librarian Bob where a geometry book is to illustrate factual versus tacit know-how responses.
methods.evidence: Alice the student constructs a stack of dominos to asks the librarian Bob a Quantum Question about where a Geometry book is

key_findings: The essay contrasts "gap-filling" epistemic modes (solid, wide, slow) with "gap-respecting" modes (diaphanous, fast).
It argues that responding to a question involves at least two archetypal modes: resolving it toward known answers, or "canal jumping" to reframe it.
The second response mode is said to reflect Subject Matter Expertise and also present as Prediction Matter Expertise.
It concludes that language is gap-respecting.
key_findings_evidence: “Gap-respecting” epistemic modes are diaphanous and fast
you are always already in a situation where your agency over the strategy of the response contains (a minimum of) two archetypal modes.

abstract: Way Finding in the Infinite Imaginarium explores epistemic tempos and modes of knowledge production, using structured operational frameworks to navigate creative and intellectual exploration. The work juxtaposes different rhythms of knowing—from rapid intuitive insight to slow deliberate analysis—within creative production contexts.
